shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- source ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- entry ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 'theming|--g-|Chart|charts|chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart; printf '\\n--- chart docs index ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- chart package ---\\n'; node -p \"JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json').peerDependencies)\"; printf '\\n--- theme docs ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|--g-color-base-background|text-primary|line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md && printf '\\n--- line ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md && printf '\\n--- chart theme ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md && printf '\\n--- root files ---\\n' && cat index.html && cat tsconfig.json"
